info.title: Smart Home - Automation Rules & Actuators API
info.description: Deterministic RESTful API for automation rules, event evaluation, cooldown enforcement, and actuator command execution.

get.description: The system shall expose GET /health returning deterministic local persistence health.
The system shall expose GET /actuators accepting optional type, prefix, and owner_id.

post.description: The system shall expose POST /actuators as an admin-only endpoint returning 201 with Location.

get.description: The system shall expose GET /actuators/{actuator_id} returning actuator metadata and current_value.

patch.description: The system shall expose PATCH /actuators/{actuator_id} as an admin-only endpoint.

delete.description: The system shall expose DELETE /actuators/{actuator_id} deleting unreferenced actuators only.

post.description: The system shall expose POST /actuators/{actuator_id}/commands creating an immutable MANUAL command.

get.description: The system shall expose GET /actuators/{actuator_id}/commands with optional origin filtering.
The system shall expose GET /automation-rules with optional filters and stable pagination.

post.description: The system shall expose POST /automation-rules creating rule and action definitions.

get.description: The system shall expose GET /automation-rules/{rule_id} returning rule and ordered actions.

put.description: The system shall expose PUT /automation-rules/{rule_id} replacing rule definition and actions.

delete.description: The system shall expose DELETE /automation-rules/{rule_id} deleting only an unexecuted rule.

post.description: The system shall expose POST /automation-rules/{rule_id}/enable setting enabled true.
The system shall expose POST /automation-rules/{rule_id}/disable setting enabled false.

post.summary: Post automation event for rule evaluation
post.description: The system shall expose POST /automation-events creating an event and evaluating matching rules.

get.description: The system shall expose GET /automation-executions accepting optional rule_id, outcome, client_event_id.
